claim: A sample match reaches its end screen.
sandbox: Fresh browser context; open /demo; finish the sample match; assert the final score screen.

claim: A rematch resets the score and uses the next stadium rule.
sandbox: Fresh demo context; end a match; choose Play another match; assert a 0–0 score and the next rule.

claim: Game settings stay in this browser.
sandbox: Fresh browser context; choose assist mode; reload; assert the checked setting.

claim: Demo state stays separate from real match data.
sandbox: Fresh browser context; finish and reset a demo; start for real; assert a 0–0 non-demo match.

claim: Demo play sends no match data away from the Codekick site.
sandbox: Record every request in a fresh demo context during a finished sample match; assert same-origin requests only.

claim: A local two-player match starts without sign-in, payment, or a download.
sandbox: Fresh browser context; select Local two players; assert the game and player-two controls.

claim: A fresh local match has a four-minute clock.
sandbox: Fresh browser context; load the game; assert 4:00 then a live countdown after kickoff.

claim: An unfinished local match returns after a reload.
sandbox: Fresh browser context; start Local two players; allow state to save; reload; assert mode and clock return.

claim: Keyboard controls move the active player.
sandbox: Fresh browser context; hold D; assert the accessible player position changes.

claim: Touch controls move the active player on a phone.
sandbox: Fresh phone context; hold the right control; assert the accessible player position changes.

claim: Codekick targets 60 frames per second on a mid-range phone.
sandbox: Fresh phone profile; sample 120 requestAnimationFrame intervals; assert at least 55 fps for measurement variance.

claim: The sample match starts with 28 seconds.
sandbox: Fresh demo context; assert the initial 0:28 clock and that it counts down.

claim: Practice runs a populated 2v2 match against bots.
sandbox: Fresh demo context; assert four players and observe a Tide bot position change.

claim: Possession shows a two-second combo and pass, shot, and goals change play.
sandbox: Seeded demo possession; observe combo, pass release, shot, and score change through real controls.

claim: A second local player can move, pass, and shoot by keyboard or touch.
sandbox: Fresh local demo on desktop and phone; operate player two movement, pass, and shot; assert position, ball, and score outcomes.

claim: Crosswind, Spring turf, and Pinched goals rotate across rematches.
sandbox: Fresh demo; play three rematches; assert each rule in order and return to Crosswind.

claim: Pause works during kickoff and active local play.
sandbox: Fresh local match; pause at kickoff and during play; assert the clock freezes and resumes.

claim: Reduced motion and remapped pass and shot keys persist.
sandbox: Fresh demo; reduce motion and remap pass; reload; assert settings and use the new key to pass.

claim: Assist mode slows player movement.
sandbox: Fresh local matches; measure the same held movement with assist off and on; assert the assisted distance is lower.

claim: The local match uses deterministic fixed-step simulation.
sandbox: Run two engines through the same 360 fixed input frames and assert identical serialized outcomes.

claim: Normal play and public pages load no third-party assets, analytics, or ads.
sandbox: Fresh browser; record requests across normal play and public routes; assert all requests remain on the site origin.

claim: Two to four friends can join one server-authoritative private match by a six-character room code.
sandbox: Four independent browser contexts create and join one real room; assert unique roles, shared movement, and the four-player boundary.

claim: A room match reaches an end screen and starts a synchronized rematch.
sandbox: Independent clients run a short test-server match to the end; start a rematch and assert the shared score and next rule.

claim: A production room match starts with a four-minute clock.
sandbox: Construct a production-duration authoritative match and assert 240 seconds and a 0–0 score.

claim: Room state persists across a service restart and expires after six hours.
sandbox: Write a room to a temporary SQLite database, reopen the service state, and assert room, player slot, tick, and expiry.

claim: Excess room creation returns HTTP 429 with Retry-After.
sandbox: Issue the allowed room requests from one address, then assert HTTP 429 and Retry-After: 60.

claim: The room service health check verifies SQLite access.
sandbox: Open a temporary SQLite database and assert the health handler returns HTTP 200.
